question: Tell me about Gopalan PU College Whitefield.
answer:
Gopalan Pre-University College, Whitefield (Hoodi, behind SAP Labs) is part of the Gopalan Group of Institutions, with 20+ years of academic excellence.
It offers Science (PCMB, PCMC) with NEET/JEE/KCET coaching and Commerce (CEBA, SEBA, MEBA) with CA Foundation coaching.

question: Where is Gopalan PU College Whitefield located?
answer: 181/1, 182/1, Behind SAP Labs, Seetharam Palya, Basavanagar, Hoodi, Bangalore - 560 048 (Hoodi Village, Sonnenahalli, K.R. Puram).

question: Who is the Principal of Gopalan PU College Whitefield?
answer: The Principal is Dr. Kanchana A S. The Academic Head is Mr. Mahesh (Chemistry; MSc, MPhil, BEd).

question: Who is the Director of Gopalan PU College?
answer: Mrs. Sunita Prabhakar, Director, Gopalan Foundation.

question: What Science combinations are offered at Whitefield?
answer:
PCMB (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology) and PCMC (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Computer Science).
Integrated coaching: NEET (PCMB), JEE and KCET (PCMB & PCMC).

question: Do you offer NEET, JEE or KCET coaching?
answer:
Yes. NEET coaching for PCMB students, and JEE and KCET coaching for PCMB & PCMC students, integrated with the PU curriculum.
It includes structured study material, crash courses and weekly mock tests.

question: What Commerce combinations are offered at Whitefield?
answer: CEBA (Computer Science, Economics, Business Studies, Accountancy), SEBA (Statistics, Economics, Business Studies, Accountancy) and MEBA (Mathematics, Economics, Business Studies, Accountancy), plus CA Foundation coaching.

question: Is CA Foundation coaching available?
answer: Yes. CA Foundation coaching gives structured preparation in accounting, economics and business laws for aspiring Chartered Accountants.

question: What languages can I choose at Gopalan PU College Whitefield?
answer:
I Language: English (mandatory).
II Language: Kannada, Hindi, Sanskrit or French.

question: What value-added courses are available?
answer: NATA Coaching, Data Analytics with Advanced Excel, Tally, Introduction to Data Science, and Coursera online certification courses.

question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission?
answer: You must have passed the Karnataka SSLC Examination or an equivalent examination recognised by the Department of Pre-University Education, Karnataka, and meet all prescribed eligibility criteria.

question: What documents are required for admission?
answer:
Two sets of photocopies: original 10th TC, attested 10th marks card, 10th hall ticket, caste & income certificate, study certificate, Aadhaar (student & parents), 5 photos (white background), PU Board application and enrollment forms.
If applicable: eligibility/migration certificate (outside Karnataka, CBSE/ICSE, NRI), transport application, medical certificate.

question: How do I apply for admission?
answer:
Admissions are open for 2027-28. Fill the enquiry form on the website or call +91 96069 41908 / (080) 41280227.
Submit the required documents (two sets of photocopies) at the time of admission.

question: What is the fee structure for 1st PU?
answer:
Fee amounts are not published on the website.
Please contact the admissions desk at +91 96069 41908 / (080) 41280227 or admission_gpuc@gopalanpucollege.com for current fees.

question: Are scholarships available?
answer: The college mentions merit-based scholarships. Criteria are not published online; please contact the admissions desk at +91 96069 41908.

question: What sports and campus facilities are available?
answer:
Football and cricket grounds, lawn tennis, badminton, table tennis, gymnastics, science labs, library, cafeteria, amphitheatre, girls' hostel and GPS-enabled transport.
Also digital classrooms and 24/7 CCTV surveillance.

question: Is hostel facility available?
answer:
Yes, a safe and well-supervised residential facility exclusively for girls.
For hostel fees and availability, contact +91 96069 41908.

question: Is bus transportation facility available?
answer:
Yes, GPS-enabled transport serves students across key city routes; submit a Transportation Application at admission.
For routes, stops and fees, call +91 96069 41908.

question: Can I visit the campus for admission counselling?
answer:
Yes, you are welcome to visit. Visiting hours are not published, so please call +91 96069 41908 / (080) 41280227 to fix a time.
Campus: Behind SAP Labs, Seetharam Palya, Basavanagar, Hoodi, Bangalore - 560 048.

answer: Office hours are not published on the website. Please call +91 96069 41908 or (080) 41280227 before visiting.

question: Are mobile phones allowed on campus?
answer: Cell phones are strictly prohibited in all academic areas. A confiscated phone is returned only at the end of the course or after a Rs. 1,000 fine.

question: Can PU students bring two-wheelers or bikes to college?
answer: No. Two-wheelers and four-wheelers are not permitted to PUC students.

question: What happens if a student arrives late or takes leave?
answer:
Late arrivals are marked ABSENT for the day. Leaving during working hours needs written permission of the mentor/HOD and Principal.
Leave must be approved in advance by the class in-charge, and minimum attendance norms apply.

question: Tell me about the faculty.
answer:
The faculty includes the Principal, Academic Head, and teams in Science, Commerce and Languages, described as highly experienced and KTET/CTET-qualified.
Science Coordinator: Mr. Krishna Murthy Goud; Commerce Co-ordinator: Ms. Lekha K S.

question: What events happen at the college?
answer: Recent events include the Investiture Ceremony, Freshers Day, Yoga Day, Environment Day, Drug Awareness Program, Talents Day, Statistics Day, Drawing Competition, Saraswathi Puja and field trips.

question: What is the vision of Gopalan PU College?
answer: To emerge as a centre of academic excellence that nurtures confident, competent and value-driven individuals, preparing students for higher education and future professional challenges.

answer: Please mail your resume to careers@gopalancolleges.com.
